page.title: Automations
page.description: Tasks Toskar's AI does for you on a schedule, such as a morning news brief or a price watch. They run in the background, even when this window is closed.
page.emptyDescription: Describe a recurring check, such as a morning price or a Friday release summary, and Toskar will run it on that schedule.
page.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}”? Its history is removed too.
page.selectHint: Select an automation to see its history, or create one.

intro.title: Put Toskar to work while you're away

when.title: Say when
when.body: Every morning, every Friday, every few hours, or just once.

what.title: Say what to do
what.body: Toskar's AI does it on its own: reads a page, sums up the news, checks a price. It can use the web and the tools you allow.

tell.title: Choose when you hear
tell.body: Every time, only when something changes, or when a condition is met. Every result is kept in its history.

news.title: Morning news brief
news.body: A short summary of the day's tech news, every morning.
news.request: Every morning at 7:30 AM, summarize today's top technology news.

price.title: Price watch
price.body: Hear when something you want drops below your price.
price.request: Every morning at 8:00 AM, check this product and tell me if the price is below $500.

stock.title: Back in stock
stock.body: Hear as soon as a sold-out item can be bought again.
stock.request: Every 6 hours, check whether this item is back in stock and tell me when it becomes available.

releases.title: Weekly release notes
releases.body: What changed in software you use, every Friday.
releases.request: Every Friday at 9:00 AM, check for new releases of this software and summarize what changed.

page.title: Page watch
page.body: Hear only when a page you care about changes.
page.request: Every day at 6:00 PM, check this page and notify me only when it changes.

detail.notRunYet: This automation has not run yet.

notice.firstSaved: The first result is saved for comparison.
notice.noPrice: The result did not include a price.
notice.notSignificant: The result was not marked significant.

notify.priceAbove: Notify when the price is above {{amount}}
notify.priceBelow: Notify when the price is below {{amount}}
notify.significant: Notify when the result is significant

parse.noTime8: No time was given, so this runs at 8:00 AM.
parse.noTime9: No time was given, so this runs at 9:00 AM.
parse.describeWhen: Describe when it should run, for example “every morning at 8:00 AM”.
parse.evening: Evening means 6:00 PM unless you set another time.
parse.night: Night means 9:00 PM unless you set another time.
parse.afternoon: Afternoon means 3:00 PM unless you set another time.
parse.morning: Morning means 8:00 AM unless you set another time.
parse.unreadable: That description could not be read.

form.intro: Tell Toskar what you want it to do.
form.describePlaceholder: Every morning at 8:00 AM, check this product and tell me if the price is below $500.
form.describeHint: Say when it runs and what to do. Toskar fills in the details below, and you can change any of them.
form.ideaHint: Edit the words to fit, such as a link in place of “this page”, then choose Fill in the details again.
form.name: Name
form.taskHint: What Toskar does each time it runs.
form.noticesGo: Notices go to the bell in Toskar and, if Settings allow, to this computer's notifications.
form.installModel: Install a model before creating an automation.
form.conditionHint: Toskar checks the result against this condition. The task itself stays in ordinary language.
form.tools: Tools it may use while you're away
form.toolsHint: Approve what this automation needs now; nobody will be around to answer later. If it reaches a tool you didn't approve, it skips it and you get a notification. Leave everything unchecked to use only the read-only tools the profile allows.
form.changeTools: These change things on this computer
form.changeToolsHint: Approve one only if this automation needs it. It will run without asking.
form.wouldNotNotify: A notice would not be sent
form.testHint: Runs it once now without saving, so you can see what you'd get.
